name: China Social Data: WeChat, Weibo, Bilibili, Douban
description: Public data from four Chinese platforms with no login: WeChat Official Account article search (公众号), Weibo posts, comments and hot search, Bilibili videos, comments and danmaku, and Douban movie/book ratings and reviews. Hosted on Apify's MCP server; tools are the pay-per-event Apify Actors dheerajitbhu/wechat-articles-scraper, dheerajitbhu/weibo-scraper, dheerajitbhu/bilibili-scraper and dheerajitbhu/douban-scraper. Sign in with an Apify account (OAuth); runs are billed to that account. WeChat full-article text is often behind a verification page right now, and Weibo search without login is shallow.
author: Integration Yard
